goal: Shoppers collect items in a cart before buying.

properties.statement: Adding an item to the cart raises the cart subtotal by the price shown on its listing.

read_as.applies_to: adding an item to the cart (cart subtotal)
read_as.action: add listing to cart, which changes the cart subtotal
read_as.compares: cart subtotal after add vs before add plus the price on the listing (listing price is the reference)

cases.what: Start with an empty cart. Open the Vintage Brass Diving Helmet listing from the home page, note its price, click Add to cart. Open /cart and read the subtotal.
cases.stands_for: Basic add of a single item to an empty cart: subtotal rises by the listing price.
cases.observed: Cart started empty (badge 0). Listing l1 Vintage Brass Diving Helmet price $249.99. Clicked Add to cart. The /cart page shows 1 item at $249.99, and Subtotal: $249.99. This equals 0 + 249.99.

steps.words: click link "🤿 Vintage Brass Diving Helmet $249.99"

cases.what: With the cart already holding one item, open a different listing with a cents price (Ship in a Bottle, $34.50), click Add to cart, and compare the cart subtotal before and after.
cases.stands_for: Add of a different item to a non-empty cart; fractional prices.
cases.observed: Cart had Vintage Brass Diving Helmet, subtotal $249.99. Listing l2 price $34.50. After clicking Add to cart on the listing page, the cart subtotal was $284.49 (= 249.99 + 34.50). The cart lists both items, and the badge shows 2.

cases.what: On the same listing already in the cart, click Add to cart again (and a third time). Check the subtotal after each click against the previous one plus the listing price.
cases.stands_for: Repeat add of an existing cart line increases the quantity, and the subtotal rises by the price each time.
cases.observed: Listing l1 price $249.99. After the 1st add the cart subtotal was $249.99 (Qty 1). After the 2nd add it was $499.98 (Qty 2), which is 249.99 + 249.99. After the 3rd add it was $749.97 (Qty 3), which is 499.98 + 249.99. Each click raised the subtotal by exactly the listing price.

cases.what: Open the sold-out Pirate Chest (Key Lost) listing, look for and try Add to cart, and report whether the cart or its subtotal changes.
cases.stands_for: Sold-out listing refused; subtotal must not change.
cases.observed: Listing l6 Pirate Chest (Key Lost), $75.25, Availability: Sold out. It has a disabled "Sold out" button plus an enabled "Add to cart" button. I clicked Add to cart; the page then showed "This item is no longer available." The cart badge stayed 0 and /cart said "Your cart is empty", so the subtotal did not change. See screenshot shot-1.
cases.question: Is it intended that a sold-out listing refuses Add to cart with the message "This item is no longer available.", leaving the cart and subtotal unchanged?
cases.draft_if_intended: Sold-out listings cannot be added to the cart; Add to cart shows "This item is no longer available." and the cart subtotal does not change.

steps.words: click link "🏴‍☠️ Pirate Chest (Key Lost) $75.25 SOLD OUT"

cases.what: Open an unknown listing address such as /listings/l999 and look for a way to add to cart; report if there is none.
cases.observed: /listings/l999 shows a 404 "This page could not be found." with no Add to cart button and no listing price. The property covers adding a listing "on its listing" with a price shown, and no such listing exists here. Cart count stayed 0.

cases.what: Add each of the other available listings (Kraken Plush $89.00, Antique Sextant $120.00, Message in a Bottle $15.00, Taxidermy Swordfish $310.00, Lighthouse Lamp Lens $199.99) one by one, checking the subtotal rise each time against the price shown on that listing page.
cases.stands_for: Different price values, smallest and largest, across the catalog.
cases.observed: Cart started empty. Subtotals read on /cart after each add from the listing page: Kraken Plush (page $89.00): 0 -> $89.00. Antique Sextant ($120.00): 89.00 -> $209.00. Message in a Bottle ($15.00): 209.00 -> $224.00. Taxidermy Swordfish ($310.00): 224.00 -> $534.00. Lighthouse Lamp Lens ($199.99): 534.00 -> $733.99. Each rise equals the listing price. Pirate Chest (l6) was sold out and was skipped; Ship in a Bottle (l2) was not added.

cases.what: With the cart empty, open the Message in a Bottle listing ($15.00), click Add to cart, read the cart subtotal. Then add the Ship in a Bottle ($34.50) from its listing and read the subtotal again.
cases.stands_for: Different items with different prices, including an odd cents value; each add raises subtotal by that listing's price.

I clicked Add to cart on the l5 listing page, and the cart subtotal became $15.00 (an increase of $15.00). I then clicked Add to cart on the l2 listing page, and the subtotal became $49.50 (an increase of $34.50). Both increases match the listed prices. The cart lines showed Qty 1 each and the cart badge went from 1 to 2.

cases.stands_for: Adding an item already in the cart (quantity increments); subtotal should rise by the listed price again.
cases.observed: Listing price $120.00. After the first add, the cart showed Qty 1, line $120.00, Subtotal $120.00. After the second add from the same listing page, it showed Qty 2, line $240.00, Subtotal $240.00. The increase was $120.00, which matches the listing price.
